findings.label: Concurrent-registration race (TOCTOU)
findings.detail: The duplicate check is a SELECT loop followed by an UPDATE with no lock and no elevated isolation (default READ COMMITTED), so two same-face registrations that overlap in time can both pass and both commit. If the one-face-one-account guarantee must hold under concurrency, take a transaction-scoped advisory lock (or LOCK TABLE profiles IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE, or SERIALIZABLE isolation) inside the function.

findings.label: search_path weakened to public
findings.detail: The prior 0028 version and sibling attendance_check_in use SET search_path = ''; this function uses SET search_path = public. All internal calls are schema-qualified so practical risk is low, but it is a regression from the hardened posture the rest of the face code holds. Restore '' for consistency.

findings.label: Linear scan per registration
findings.detail: Every registration scans all profiles holding a valid-length descriptor and runs face_similarity (1434-dim) for each, so cost is O(n) per signup. Fine at current staff counts; add a partial index or cap the candidate set once the account base grows.
